title: Every first-party agent is handed all 50 tools (~8.8k tokens of definitions) on every round, including the default local 8B lane with a 16k window: past both published tool-count thresholds, with no deferral or domain subsetting
repro: In-process at HEAD f763a44: `from services import agent_runtime as ar; spec=ar.get_agent('copilot'); len(spec.tools)` -> 50; `len(json.dumps(openai_tools(spec.tools)))//4` -> 8806 tokens, plus copilot system prompt ~2741 tokens. Same 50 for researcher/buffett. A read-intent turn still sends 37 tools (~6422 tokens). Ollama lane num_ctx=16384, so ~70% of the local window is spent before the terminal preamble, history or any tool result. (Token counts are chars/4 estimates; tiktoken is absent from the venv. Ollama's reported prompt_eval_count of ~2.8k on the vy.py drives in WLD-harness-tools-3 is consistent with prefix KV-cache reuse, not a count of the full prompt. Unresolved, flagged for refute.)
evidence: sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:189-221 (_grant_first_party_hands unions the FULL default_grant set into every first-party agent), sidecar/services/agent_tools/catalog.py:1531-1540 (default_grant_tool_ids = every internal capability; default_grant never False per COD-agent-tools-catalog-ledger-4), sidecar/services/agent_tools/schemas.py:51-97 (all definitions serialised every call), sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:1286-1305 (the only subsetting: read-intent strips host actions, leaving 37), sidecar/services/llm/ollama.py:47 (DEFAULT_NUM_CTX = 16384), sidecar/services/agent_tools/catalog.py:954-1175 (four ways to put a symbol on screen: open_panel(symbol), set_chart_symbol, open_company_overview, arrange_layout(symbol)); https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/function-calling ('Aim for fewer than 20 functions available at the start of a turn at any one time'); https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/tool-search-tool ('Claude's ability to pick the right tool degrades once you exceed 30-50 available tools.'; 'Use tool search when ... You have 10 or more tools available. Your tool definitions consume more than 10k tokens.'); https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-context-engineering-for-ai-agents ('If a human engineer can't definitively say which tool should be used in a given situation, an AI agent can't be expected to do better.')
notes: Principle: tool-selection accuracy falls with tool count and definition tokens (research T-3/T-6, checklist 3/4/6). The published thresholds are frontier-model numbers, and the product's default free lane is llama3.1:8b. The R10 E5 grant-everything decision correctly killed the 'I don't have a backtesting tool' drift, but it set selection accuracy and local context budget to their worst values. Related but distinct filed items: COD-agent-runtime-8 (prose restatement of the catalog), COD-agent-tools-catalog-ledger-4 (default_grant is a dead knob), SURF-COMPOSER-CHAT-1 (local-lane calls leak as text; the count is a plausible contributor, not proven here). With trading removed, propose_order and broker_portfolio leave, giving 48, which does not change the verdict. Smallest fix, catalog-driven and keeping the E5 guarantee: add a `hot: bool` plus the existing `domain` to the projection. Send the hot core every round (resolve_symbol, research, price_data, fundamentals, market_overview, get_terminal_state, the read-safe panel actions; about 12 tools). Add a domain's tools when classify_intent or the previous round names that domain (filings, quant, macro, screener, portfolio-write, workspace-write). On Anthropic, mark non-hot tools defer_loading behind tool search instead. Measure with the scenario suite in WLD-harness-tools-2 before and after.

title: No agent eval loop exists: no fixed real-data scenario set, no grader, no pass^k, nothing re-run when a tool, description, prompt or adapter changes. Every agent test runs against fakes, which is how an adapter that sends {} args on every call shipped green
repro: design: search the repo for any scenario runner, grader or reliability metric. None exists (find for *eval*/*golden*/*scenario* returns only verification JSON). Agent tests declare 'No network, no real LLM, no real tool registry'. The Anthropic test fixture emits content_block_start with a pre-filled input, a shape the real API never sends, so COD-llm-adapters-2-1 (every Anthropic tool call dispatched with input={}) passes CI. It was found only by a census worker replaying the wire shape by hand (re-confirmed in this pass: scratch wld-tools/anth_stream_probe.py -> 'TOOL_USE_EVENT name=price_data input={}').
evidence: sidecar/tests/test_research_fast.py:3 ('No network, no real LLM, no real tool registry'), sidecar/tests/test_llm_anthropic.py:165-171 (fixture feeds input={'symbol':'AAPL'} on content_block_start), sidecar/services/llm/anthropic.py:224-231, scripts/r15/vy.py:1-11 (a key-safe headless driver already exists), docs/redesign/verification/r13/battery/BATTERY_MANIFEST.md (17 real-data reference packs already exist), sidecar/services/action_ledger.py:47-87 (host-action outcomes already recorded, which is an end-state signal), docs/redesign/verification/r15/census/world/harness-tools-COMPARE.md (rows 21-25); https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/multi-agent-research-system ('We started with a set of about 20 queries representing real usage patterns. Testing these queries often allowed us to clearly see the impact of changes.'; 'evaluate whether it achieved the correct final state'); https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.12045 ('a new metric (pass^k) to evaluate the reliability of agent behavior over multiple trials'; 'pass^8 <25% in retail'); https://gorilla.cs.berkeley.edu/blogs/13_bfcl_v3_multi_turn.html (missing-parameter and missing-function categories)
notes: Principle: research checklist 21-25. For a multi-provider BYOK harness (8 providers, per-model quirks), a tool/description/adapter change is only safe if a fixed scenario set is replayed per lane. This census has hand-found at least four lane-specific breaks the suite would flag on day one: COD-llm-adapters-2-1 Anthropic {} args, SURF-COMPOSER-CHAT-1 local leak, SURF-COMPOSER-CHAT-10 narration drift, WLD-harness-tools-3 invented cost basis. The product's stated moat is 'a finance-tuned agent'; that claim cannot be measured today. Smallest fix, using parts that already exist: a scripts/evals/ runner built on vy.py's invoke path, with ~20 scenarios drawn from the R13/R15 repros (resolve an Indian small cap, research quick, compare, screener stage, add position with and without price, missing-function asks). Grade end state first: the tool name plus required args present, action_ledger outcome, brief.structured values checked against the reference pack. Then run one LLM-judge rubric call (free lane). Run k=3 per lane and report pass^3. Wire the local lane into ci-local as a non-blocking report and the paid lanes as a pre-tag gate under the vy.py budget cap. Also add a wire-shape replay test per adapter (the anth_stream_probe pattern) so fixtures cannot drift from the real protocol.

title: A missing required argument becomes a fabricated or zero cost basis in the user's tracked portfolio: the local lane never asks for the price (3/3), nothing validates host-action args, the frontend coerces null to 0, the review card omits the cost, and AUTO applies it unreviewed
repro: `python3 scripts/r15/vy.py invoke copilot "I bought 40 shares of Sumax Enterprises last month. Add them to my portfolio." --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b --mode agent --autonomy ask --port 52152` x3 ($0). The portfolio_add_position inputs were: run1 {symbol:'SUMAX.NS', quantity:40, cost_basis:null, purchased_at:'2026-08-23'}; run2 {symbol:'Sumax Enterprises', quantity:40, cost_basis:1000, ...} (price invented, narrated as '$1000'); run3 {symbol:'Sumax Enterprises', quantity:40, cost_basis:0, ...}. None of the 3 asked the user for the price. The sidecar returns a synthetic ok/awaiting_user_review for every host action without validating args. On apply, positionBody sets costBasis = typeof cost_basis==='number' ? cost_basis : 0, so null becomes ₹0 and 1000 is stored as fact. The review-card title drops the cost when it is falsy ('Add 40 SUMAX.NS to the paper portfolio'), so the reviewer is never shown that no price was given. Under autonomy=auto, kind 'data-write' auto-applies (only 'order' is excluded). 2/3 runs also sent the company name as the symbol, which becomes a holding named 'SUMAX ENTERPRISES'. Events: scratch wld-tools/cost-basis-run{1,2,3}.jsonl.
evidence: sidecar/services/agent_tools/catalog.py:1308-1334 (cost_basis required; the description never says to ask when the user gave no price), sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:1188-1220 (host-action handler returns ok without validating args), sidecar/services/llm/ollama.py:133-170 (no schema validation on the Ollama lane; only openai.py:198 validates, see COD-llm-adapters-1), src/lib/host-actions.ts:762-775 (describe: cost omitted from title when falsy), src/lib/host-actions.ts:1262-1266 (positionBody coerces a non-number cost_basis to 0), src/lib/host-actions.ts:1332-1352 (apply adds the holding), src/store/proposed-changes.ts:118 (auto-apply for any kind !== 'order'); https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/overview ('Claude Sonnet might ask ... But it might also infer a reasonable value.'; 'This behavior is not guaranteed, especially for more ambiguous prompts and for less capable models.')
notes: Principle: research T-30/P5: validate required args in the handler and assume a cheaper model guesses rather than asks. The tracked portfolio (holdings, cost bases, P&L) is explicitly in scope after the 23 Sep trading removal and is the product's one money-relevant write surface. A ₹0 basis shows the whole market value as unrealised gain, and an invented ₹1000 basis shows a fictional P&L. Both are presented as the user's own numbers. Distinct from filed items: COD-portfolio-8 (restore path accepts garbage), COD-portfolio-11 (per-share vs total unit), SURF-COMPOSER-CHAT-7 (invented watchlist ticker), COD-llm-adapters-1 (adapter-side schema parity). Validation would reject null here but NOT an invented 1000, so the fix needs all three parts. (1) The sidecar host-action handler validates required numerics (> 0) and returns a steering error: 'cost_basis missing: ask the user what they paid per share; do not estimate'. (2) The capability description says to ask for a missing price, never estimate, and to call resolve_symbol first. (3) The review card always shows cost basis, flagging 'not given' in red, and data-write proposals whose required money field was absent never auto-apply. Add this exact case to the WLD-harness-tools-2 suite as a missing-parameter scenario.

title: Gemini thought signatures are dropped on multi-round tool turns: the adapter keeps only name/args and rebuilds function_call parts without the signature Google documents as required for function calling on Gemini 3
repro: design (code read) + NOT TESTED live. GeminiProvider.stream_chat reads only fc.name / fc.id / fc.args from each part (the Part's thought_signature field, present in google-genai 2.5.0, `'thought_signature' in types.Part.model_fields` -> True, is never read). LLMToolUseEvent has no slot to carry it. _split_system_and_contents rebuilds the model turn as {'function_call': {name, args}} parts. Round 2 of any Gemini 3 tool turn therefore replays function calls without their signatures. Live confirmation needs a Gemini key (none funded on this run's lanes). Cost: one 2-round agent invoke on a Gemini 3 Flash-class model, < $0.01.
evidence: sidecar/services/llm/gemini.py:155-163 (only name/id/args captured), sidecar/models/llm.py:146-152 (LLMToolUseEvent: tool_call_id, name, input only), sidecar/services/llm/gemini.py:67-83 (function_call parts rebuilt from name+args), sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:1530-1542 (runtime metadata carries id/name/input only), sidecar/services/llm/gemini.py:205-233 (live catalog lists every generateContent model, so Gemini 3 is selectable although the registry default is gemini-2.5-pro); https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/thinking.md.txt (line 645: 'Gemini 3 models may return thought signatures for all types of parts. We recommend you always pass all signatures back as received, but it's *required* for function calling signatures.'; line 649: 'Return the entire response with all parts back to the model in subsequent turns.'; line 651: 'Don't merge one part with a signature with another part without a signature.'); https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/gemini-3.md.txt (line 226: 'If you are managing conversation history manually, you must include thought blocks with their signatures in subsequent requests to validate authenticity.')
notes: Principle: research P2 (echo reasoning state verbatim; rules differ by model). The runtime already solved the analogous DeepSeek-reasoner echo (agent_runtime.py:1527-1529) and the Gemini name-pairing trap (P1). The signature is the third member of that family and is missing. It compounds with COD-llm-adapters-2-3: Google documents the function+google_search round the runtime sends as valid only on Gemini 3, and Gemini 3 is exactly where dropping the signature is documented as required. So no Gemini model is documented-correct for a multi-round agent turn today. On Gemini 2.5 (the default) the signature is returned with thinking plus function calling, and dropping it degrades reasoning continuity rather than being a documented hard failure. Smallest fix: add an optional `provider_meta: dict` to LLMToolUseEvent, capture part.thought_signature (bytes, base64 in transit) in gemini.py, carry it through metadata['tool_calls'][i], and re-attach it to the matching function_call part in _split_system_and_contents. Add a wire-shape replay test per WLD-harness-tools-2.
